card.name: Words just before lupus, lymphoma, mastocytosis
card.fires_on: The word "systemic" (or CNS and a closing bracket) right before a disease name such as lupus, ALCL, mastocytosis or lymphoma. Also fires on "in" after "aortitis has been reported".
